scope: projection of native subtracted events with common nominal masses; not full-generator parity

1.scope:
Replay projected native events through the frozen, safe-range Fortran probe.

Nominal masses are supplied identically: this tests the projection operation,
not Pythia6/Pythia8 mass-table equivalence or the whole generator.

2.scope:
Replay projected native events through the frozen, safe-range Fortran probe.

Nominal masses are supplied identically: this tests the projection operation,
not Pythia6/Pythia8 mass-table equivalence or the whole generator.

native_analysis.scope: Native reduced PPJJ development samples; no Fortran comparison

selection.particles: all final visible particles; exclude neutrino PDG 12/14/16
selection.recoils: per-run keep_recoils flag; use projected_particles when projection is enabled, otherwise subtracted_particles when subtraction is enabled, otherwise raw hadronized_particles

native_analysis.normalization: weighted jets per attempted event; failed events contribute zero jets; not a cross-section normalization

checks: explicit mode zero identical to omitted option
nominal photon and charged-pion masses checked
all accepted sample events replayed through frozen Fortran
